identifiedBy.fact: South Manter Meadow is the trailhead most people use for Rockhouse; Manter Creek Trail 35E12 east, then about 1 mi off trail north

placements.source: climber.org driving GPX (TAYLTH, South Manter trailhead)
placements.name: South Manter Meadow Trailhead

otherFacts.value: 9 round trip from Manter Meadow; 16.5-18 from Big Meadow

notes: Two pages (climber.org driving guide, Kern River Sierra) name South Manter as the usual start; the east approach via Long Valley/Rockhouse Basin (LNGRCK 35.8916,-118.1239, gated junction about 6800 ft) is the alternative with a much longer walk. Placements are climber.org waypoints, not land-manager; the two waypoints are about 130 m apart (TAYLTH vs MANTRS). Moderate confidence.

identifiedBy.fact: Path: Roaring Brook Trail over Giant, then the ridge trail

otherFacts.value: East Trail lot off US 9 near New Russia, N44 08.987 W73 37.608, via Bald Peak
Ridge Trail lot near Chapel Pond, N44 08.293 W73 44.626, climbs Giant

notes: Coordinate printed as degrees-minutes on a hiking site (CNY Hiking), converted by me; not a land-manager page. Search results (not opened) gave the same lot at about 44.1504,-73.7677. Roaring Brook lot is across NY 73 from the AMR/St. Huberts lot.

otherFacts.value: 2006 trip report: from Twin Island Lakes basin, bench-wall CL2 scree north of stream (CL3 south), ledge, summit ridge CL2; day 3 6 mi RT, 2880 ft gain

notes: Only one opened trip report (climber.org 2006/1567) starts at Agnew Meadows, as a multi-day backpack. Search results (not opened; SummitPost and highsierratopix 403) point to Tuolumne Meadows via Lyell Canyon/Marie Lakes, and Rush Creek (June Lake) as other starts. No page ties the Standard route to one start. Candidates: Agnew Meadows (USFS Shadow Lake TH 37.682096,-119.08618), Tuolumne Meadows, Rush Creek.

trailhead.name: SR 20 turnout across from the large boulder field, about 1,900 ft, 0.4 mi west of Horsetail Creek (about 12 mi east of Newhalem)

identifiedBy.fact: Turnout on the north side of Hwy 20 across from the boulder field on Ruby's NW side; route starts just left of the boulder field; winter closure gate at MP 134 shortly after

otherFacts.value: MP 134 closure gate (older report); a 2018 WSDOT note, not opened, says MP 130

notes: Matches the route's own text; an unsigned pullout so no coordinate printed on any page opened. Needs placing from map/ground (about 0.4 mi west of the Horsetail Creek crossing on SR 20). Happy Creek lot (3.9 km away) is a different route.

trailhead.name: Appalachian Trail Route 4 trailhead (Sandy River Plantation), lot west of ME 4

identifiedBy.fact: Park in the lot west of ME 4, cross carefully, head north on the AT; 30 mi north of Farmington or 9 mi south of Rangeley

notes: Route name itself names the start. The page printed only a geocache link coordinate near 44.912,-70.521, not labelled as the trailhead, so not reported as a placement. Place by OSM name match.

trailhead.name: Minaret Summit / Minaret Vista (gated road above Mammoth Mountain)

identifiedBy.fact: San Joaquin Ridge hike starts near Minaret Summit where the road is gated; 5 mi west of Mammoth Lakes on SR-203 then 2.5 mi north on dirt road

notes: Consistent with the route text (jeep road then ridge trail). No coordinate on any opened page. A search summary (unopened SummitPost) claimed a 4WD Deadman Pass trailhead at about 37.685,-119.066; not evidence. None of the USFS candidate points is Minaret Summit.

identifiedBy.fact: Starts at Upper Works, Newcomb; Bradley Pond Trail then Santanoni Express herd path

otherFacts.value: new 60-car lot beside MacNaughton Cottage; old Upper Works lot closed

notes: Placement is a community site's map link (not land-manager), weak; the page does not cover Santanoni. A search result (unopened Trailforks) put the Bradley Pond trailhead near 44.1419,-74.1069, a different point from Upper Works; the Bradley Pond trail may start there rather than at Upper Works. Needs checking.

trailhead.name: St. Huberts parking area (Adirondack Mountain Reserve lot, NY 73)

identifiedBy.fact: Sawteeth Trailhead is the St Huberts AMR lot, across NY 73 from the Roaring Brook Falls trailhead; Weld Trail out and back

otherFacts.value: AMR parking reservation May 1 to Oct 31, required even for walk-ins (hikeamr.org)

notes: Roaring Brook lot (44.1505,-73.7678) is about 100 m away across the road, consistent.

trailhead.name: Pacific Crest Trail crossing of Canebrake Road (park at Chimney Peak Campground)

identifiedBy.fact: PCT trailhead (CANPCT) serves Sawtooth (S); small easily missed sign; parking is at Chimney Peak campground, not at the crossing

notes: CANPCT and the campground are about 330 m apart; the campground is where cars park. SAWTOS waypoint matches the peak coordinate. Moderate confidence (one guide family; a search summary, unopened, agrees on PCT from Canebrake Road, about 5 mi one way).

trailhead.name: North Lake Trailhead (hiker lot by the pack station)

identifiedBy.fact: Trip report to Scylla northwest slope (class 2): North Lake TH, Lamarck Col, Darwin Canyon, JMT, Muir Pass, Nietzsche Col, Ionian Basin

otherFacts.value: NW slope no harder than class 2
Ionian Basin lakes to summit about 1500; Nietzsche Col about 500 ft below summit

notes: Matches the route text. The two USFS points are about 1 km apart: North Lake (day use) vs Lamarck Lakes TH (hiker/camp lot at the road end by the pack station); the report says hiker lot near pack station, so Lamarck Lakes is likely the parking for this trip.

trailhead.name: Corey's Road parking area (Blueberry Trail trailhead, Seward Range)

identifiedBy.fact: Starts at Corey's Road parking area; Blueberry Trail to Seward herd path

notes: Gaia and HiiKER pages opened gave no trailhead name or coordinate. Name only; place by OSM match. Identification rests on the route's own text. Search summary (unopened): trailhead about 5.6 mi down Corey's Road; winter gate adds about 3 mi each way.
